exposure: higher maternal heart rate at discharge
cohort: The study enrolled 2930 postpartum women and their newborns following facility-based delivery in Mbarara, Uganda.
finding: The study identified significant rates of readmission and mortality among postpartum women and newborns, with caesarean delivery, longer travel time, and specific maternal and newborn health indicators at discharge being significant risk factors.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was significantly associated with maternal readmission.
